_doc: Demo47 thermal plan (DUAL). A game, not a timeline: the build stage drives these sources from the game state. Special setting (told in b03 and y02): ghosts are COOL (like the snow spirit, guide §0 rule 2 exception) — a ghost's cold reaches the ear on its side 1.5–2 s before it arrives (cool rise 0.2 s), a touch = a short cold puff. Bon-chan's candle is WARM and is where you point it. Every other source is real.

ghost.level: 0 → 0.55 as it approaches (distance), 0.9 puff 0.4 s on a touch
ghost.why: special setting: ghosts are chilly (told on screen + in lines)

lantern.az: the side you turn it to (left / right; held up = both)
lantern.why: a real candle in the paper lantern, ~30 cm from your head

yurari_voice.why: special setting: her whisper is cool (she is a ghost; told in y02)

draught.why: a real draught + wind chime through the sliding doors

summer_night.why: warm summer night air at the gate and at the end

dark_stage.why: stage 4: screen dark, the same thermal cues = the only direction info

showcase.fast_switch: a ghost's cool on one ear → you turn the lantern → warm on the same ear within ~1 s (cool + warm, then warm only as it flees)
showcase.peak: a ghost touching your ear: 0.9 cold puff
showcase.direction: left / right / behind (both ears) ghosts; the dark storehouse is played by ear
showcase.same_ear_dual: the moment the lantern turns onto a cold ear: cool (ghost) + warm (candle) on one ear; Yurari's cool whisper next to the warm lantern at the end
